title: Kelli M. Evans
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Kelli M. Evans is a judge of the California Supreme Court. She assumed office on January 2, 2023. Her current term ends on January 4, 2027.
Evans is running for re-election for judge of the California Supreme Court. She is on the ballot in the retention election on November 3, 2026.
Gov. Gavin Newsom (D) appointed Evans to the Supreme Court after Patricia Guerrero was elevated to Chief Justice. To learn more about this appointment, click here.
